headline: OTP Considers Withdrawing from the Russian Market
summary: OTP Bank continues to examine strategic options for its Russian operations, including a possible withdrawal. Documents seen by Bloomberg show clients of the subsidiary include businesses linked to Gazprom.
why: OTP Bank is a Hungarian lender with operations across Central and Eastern Europe, and its exposure to Russia is a sanctions and reputational concern for investors.

impacts.name: OTP Bank
impacts.why: The bank is reviewing whether to keep or exit its Russian subsidiary, which affects its exposure and earnings outlook.
